==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|synagog||US}}

===Etymology===
[[File:Lauderdale Road Sephardic Synagogue (3).JPG|thumb|A ''synagogue'', with several of the architectural features traditional to such a building.]]

{{root|en|ine-pro|*sem-|*h₂eǵ-|id2=drive}}
{{inh+|en|enm|synagoge}}, from {{der|en|fro|synagoge}}, from {{der|en|la|synagōga}}, from {{der|en|grc|σῠνᾰγωγή||assembly, gathering}}, from {{m|grc|συνάγω||to gather together}}, from {{m|grc|σῠ́ν||with, together}} & {{m|grc|ᾰ̓́γω||to lead}}. {{surf|en|syn-|-agogue}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsɪnəɡɒɡ/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsɪnəˌɡɑɡ/|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|En-us-synagogue.ogg|a=GA}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪnəɡɒɡ|s=3}}
* {{hyphenation|en|syn|a|gogue}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{sid|en|Q34627}}{{lb|en|countable|Judaism}} A [[place of worship]] for [[Jew]]s.
#: {{syn|en|temple}}
#: {{hypo|en|mega-synagogue|shul}}
#* {{quote-web|en
|date=May 7, 2013
|title=Netanyahu: Jewish people capable of own defense
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220525221655/https://apnews.com/article/56b8c9bd77994cb18b5d99e4ee38bd39
|archivedate=25 May 2022
|work=w:AP News
|text=On Tuesday, Netanyahu and his wife toured Shanghai’s Ohel Moshe '''synagogue''' in the Hongkou district that was home to many of the 18,000 Jews granted refuge in Shanghai from the horrors of Nazi persecution.}}
# {{lb|en|countable|Judaism}} A [[congregation]] of [[Jew]]s for the purpose of [[worship]] or [[religious]] [[study]].
# {{lb|en|countable|rare|religion}} Any assembly of folk.
